description: List Wikipedia featured content (featured articles, featured lists, or featured pictures) for a language edition. Returns titles, page IDs, namespaces, types, and URLs. Supports multiple languages via a maintained category mapping; unmapped languages or kinds return EMPTY_RESULT.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Type of featured content to list: articles, lists, or images. Default: articles.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Must be a positive integer. Default: 20.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: MediaWiki language edition code (e.g. zh, en, ja, ko, fr, de, es, ru, pt, it). Default: zh.
